All-day ENTERTAINMENT — With 18-hour battery life, maximize your downtime for reading, browsing the web, watching videos, and listening to music at home and on-the-go. Save your favorites with 128 GB storage, and expand to up to 1 TB with TF card (sold separately).

Playful GAMING TABLET — With the MTK8786 octa-core processor and 16 GB memory easily conquer all games, to use this android tablet as a game station with big 11-inch display to maximizing your gaming experience.

Versatile FOR WORK AND PLAY — Thoughtfully packed bluetooth keyboard, mouse set, tablet case and stylus pen, screen protector, with this android tablet set you can get everything you need at once. Get a portable work station!
